sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:23163
Court No. - 27

Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 1385 of 2023
Revisionist :- Juvenile, Case Crime No.103/2023 Thru.
His Father
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Home Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Revisionist :- Asim Kumar Singh,Chandra Bhushan Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Chandra Bhushan Pandey, the learned counsel for the revisionist, Smt. Parul Kant, the
learned A.G.A appearing on behalf of the State and perused the record.

2.  The instant criminal revision has been filed under Section 102 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection) Act, 2015, challenging the validity of order dated 27.10.2023 passed by the Juvenile Justice Board, Lakhimpur Kheri rejecting the bail application of the revisionist and the judgment and order dated 02.12.2023 passed by the Learned Special Judge, Children Court, Lakhimpur Kheri,
dismissing the Criminal Appeal No. 99/2023 filed by the revisionist against rejection of his bail application.

3. The opposite party no. 2 had lodged an F.I.R No. 103/2023 under Sections 376, 5061 I.P.C, in Police Station Khamaria, District Lakhimpur Kheri on 13.07.2023 against seven persons including the revisionist, alleging that the complainant got married to one Ravi Shukla two years ago but because the revisionist said some objectionable things regarding the complainant to her husband,
the husband turned her out of her matrimonial home and divorced her.

sentences.text: allurement of marrying her, the revisionist exploited her physically for one and half year but thereafter he declined to marry her.
4. The medico-legal examination report of the victim/complainant does not contain any finding which may support the F.I.R allegations.

5. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C, she stated her age to be 20 years and in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. also she stated her age to be the same and she supported the F.I.R allegations.
The revisionist's age is 15 years.

6 A copy of the Social Inquiry Report of the revisionist submitted by District Probation Officer,
states that the complainant wanted to marry the revisionist but his family did not agree to it as he is a minor and the victim/ complainant was already married.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the victim/complainant is a major and married lady and although she contains that she had got divorced by her husband but no document of divorce has been provided by her, that the complainant claims that the revisionist who is a minor boy exploited her physically under allurement of marrying her whereas the revisionist being a minor could not have married the complainant, I am of the view that the juvenile revisionist is entitled to be released on bail.
8. Accordingly, the revision is allowed.

The order dated 27.10.2023 passed by the Juvenile Justice Board, Lakhimpur Kheri rejecting the bail application of the revisionist and the judgment and order dated 02.12.2023 passed by the Learned Special Judge, Children Court, Lakhimpur Kheri,
dismissing the Criminal Appeal No. 99/2023 are hereby set aside.
9. Let the revisionist- Juvenile, Case Crime No.103/2023 Thru.

entities.text: Special Judge, Children Court, Lakhimpur Kheri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
His Father be released on bail in the Case Crime No.103/20231, under Sections 376, 5061 I.P.C, Police Station Khamaria, District Lakhimpur Kheri, upon his guardian furnishing a personal bond with two solvent sureties of his relatives, each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Juvenile Justice Board, Lakhimpur Kheri,
subject to the following conditions:-
(i) the natural guardian will furnish an undertaking that upon release on bail the juvenile will not be permitted to come into contact or association with any known criminal or allowed to be exposed to any moral, physical or psychological danger and further that the guardian will ensure that the juvenile will not indulge in any criminal activity;
(ii) natural guardian will further furnish an undertaking to the effect that the juvenile will pursue his study at the appropriate level which he would be encouraged to do.

10. It is made clear that the observations made in this order are limited to the purpose of determination of this bail application and will in no way be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
The trial court/J.J.Board shall be absolutely free to arrive at its independent conclusions on the basis of evidence led, uninfluenced by any finding or observation whatsoever in this order.

(ii) natural guardian will further furnish an undertaking to the effect that the juvenile will pursue his study at the appropriate level which he would be encouraged to do.
(iii) juvenile accompanied by his natural guardian, will report to the Probation Officer on the first working day of every calendar month.
(iv) The District Probation Officer will keep strict vigil on the activities of the juvenile and regularly draw up his social investigation report that would be submitted to the Juvenile Justice Board, Lakhimpur Kheri.
